evals.name: bug-report-to-contract
evals.prompt: Issue #2114: open reports success when --allowed-domains blocks a redirect. Write the contract before we touch code.
evals.expected_output: A contract in .agents/verify/contract.md classified as unverified bug, size normal, with an acceptance item mapped to observe: domain-redirect, a must-not-change item for allowed navigation, and non-goals.
assertions: Classifies the intent as unverified bug, not as an accepted change
Every acceptance and must-not-change item has an observe line or a named gap
Pins the source with a digest or updatedAt

evals.name: heavy-change-stops
evals.prompt: Move session persistence from JSON files to SQLite. Start the work.
evals.expected_output: A heavy contract with persistence and migration risks, unknowns listed, and a stop for human confirmation before any shaping or code.
assertions: Stops for the human instead of continuing to loop
Lists must-not-change behavior for existing sessions
